_comment: Legacy-router override for comms-critical position alerts (2026-10-31, DD audit P1-7 + independent review of PR #2350). Cron senders run with the comms gateway OFF, so the legacy text router decides; it digested 13 comms-critical alerts in 48 h, including the 10-30 11:07 ET position-sync protective-stop rechecks. The override is narrow on purpose: comms rule in comms_rule_ids, first line matches require_first_line_match and not never_match, and the router held it by CLASSIFICATION (never health-repeat, rate limit or budget). It is then sent as a P1 notification intent (exact-body dedupe + receipt) and at most once per subject per subject_window_minutes, because the review's 48 h replay showed 10 of 13 were a self-reversing holdings-sync flap in bursts.
never_match: Health Agent:|sweep complete|cleaned up|orphaned workers|\b0 unprotected\b|\bno unprotected\b
_comment_followup: 2026-10-31 follow-up (round-2 review): a zero count ('0 unprotected positions') is telemetry, never a page; at most burst_max_pages override pages per burst_window_seconds across all subjects (one 10-30 sync burst paged 5 names in 4 s), the rest go to the digest; a P1 intent that is deduped or fails delivery is archived to the digest instead of vanishing.
_comment_burst_severity: 2026-10-31 round-3 review: the burst cap is never applied to a stop that fired or crossed or a critical stop alert (burst_exempt_first_line). A burst-held message claims its subject window, so its own reversal cannot page alone, and it is archived to the digest with reason '<level>:burst_held'.
